methodology: Cost figures are the simple (unweighted) averages of the 50 state estimates in the 2026 National Funeral Cost Index. They are not the official NFDA 2023 national medians ($8,300 for a funeral with viewing and burial; $6,280 for a funeral with viewing and cremation). The national cremation rate is the NFDA 2025 Cremation & Burial Report projection for 2025, which this site uses throughout.

rows.label: National Cremation Rate
rows.source: NFDA 2025 Cremation & Burial Report, projected for 2025
